recipeDesc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.

assumptions.method: All three legs are read off the street's forecast distribution AT THIS RECORD'S EIGHTEEN-MONTH HORIZON rather than at the nearest fiscal year: base 1,340 is the median FY2028 estimate, bull 1,410 the highest, and bear 1,200 approximates the lowest FY2027 estimate of 1,203.2. Taking all three from one distribution keeps a single horizon across the legs. The computed default of 1,351.7 is the FY2026 median and therefore describes a different moment, which is why base sits below it.

Base 15.5% matches the median operating margin of the last eight fiscal years, 15.45%, and is corroborated forward rather than extrapolated from a depressed present — the street carries about 15.5% for FY2027 and an implied 15.7% for FY2028. Bear 13.0% is roughly 0.9pp below the trailing twelve-month margin: deterioration from a level already impaired. Bull 17.0% is held below the 17.18% actually earned in FY2024, so the upside claims only what the business has already done. Stated on operating income, not EBITDA.

assumptions.method: Base 9.0x is roughly half the 17.85x median close of the company's own eight-and-a-half-year trading history, and that gap IS the judgment: the history spans a growth era the business has left, so a median drawn across it describes a company that no longer exists. The leg follows the company's own de-rating instead — it traded at 9.54x as recently as September 2025 — and is cross-checked against the 8.72x median that comparable companies fetch on next-twelve-month earnings, which it sits slightly above. Bear 5.5x is below the 6.11x lowest close in that same history, deliberately not 5.0x, because a lower multiple would count deterioration the revenue and margin legs already carry. Bull 12.0x is near the 12.89x the most expensive comparable fetches.

The 9.0x multiple is roughly half the 17.85x median close of the company's own trading history, because that history spans a growth era the business has left; it stood at 9.54x as recently as September 2025, and comparable companies trade at 8.72x on next-twelve-month earnings.

Margin 17.0% is held below the 17.18% the business actually earned in FY2024, so the upside leg claims only a margin already demonstrated rather than an extrapolation. The 12.0x multiple sits near the 12.89x that the most expensive comparable company trades at on next-twelve-month earnings, so the re-rating is bounded by what peers fetch today.

verdict.rationale:
The market prices this as a broken business in a shrinking category. It is share loss inside a growing one: retail takeaway fell 6.7% while the purposeful-nutrition category grew about 10% over the same window. Atkins is the drag at −24.6% net sales; Quest holds its share. A high-single-digit portfolio price increase takes effect in September, and the January print is the first evidence on whether it sticks. Bought at $11.33 against a $19.64 value that assumes nine times EBITDA — below where the company itself traded in September 2025, and near the median for comparable companies today. The case fails if the profit reset proves permanent rather than cyclical.

[amended 2026-08-19 (judgment): a fourth re-underwrite trigger — OWYN net sales turning negative year-over-year in any quarter. Added after management flagged further distribution losses over six to twelve months from a product-quality issue, explicitly not in the base case. OWYN grew net sales 3.6% against takeaway of −1.3%; this tests shipments catching down to consumption.]
reunderwriteTriggers: Quest revenue growth <= 0% YoY for two consecutive quarters — the growth engine is dead; re-underwrite the bull and base cases.
FY26 guidance cut at the fiscal Q4 print (~October 2026), or initial FY27 guidance below ~$1.30B — the base revenue path fails.

Gross margin below ~31% on a full-year basis, or a further decline beyond the ~4 points already absorbed — a margin regime break past what the 14% normal assumes. (The prior instance of this trigger fired on the nine-month decline and was discharged 2026-07-26 by the re-verification that re-set the normal; this is a fresh forward threshold.)
OWYN net sales turn negative year-over-year in any quarter — added 2026-08-19.
